note: Each column adds to the one before it, except “crews eat twice as much”, which doubles the crews' Food and Water on top of “crews work slower”. The last column also switches farms and wells off last when power runs short; on its own that change made no difference (13.6 Food a month). Crews that work slower help, because the farm's “dry” halving goes. Doubling what crews eat starves the colony on today's power. Slower spoilage is the best single change. No column fixes Energy: the store runs out of it in about 100 months of 120 in every one.
